parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: JobCode
parameters.description:
The task code that specifies the type of the DTS subtask. Valid values:

*   **01**: precheck.
*   **02**: schema migration or initial schema synchronization.
*   **03**: full data migration or initial full data synchronization.
*   **04**: incremental data migration or synchronization.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The filter item used to filter tables in fuzzy match.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: StructPhase
parameters.description: The filter item used to filter tables, views, and functions during schema migration.

parameters.name: StructType
parameters.description:
The type of schema definition. Valid values:

*   **before**: schema migration or initial schema synchronization.
*   **after**: DDL operations performed during incremental data migration or synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Whether it is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) task, the value can be:
- **false**: No. - **true**: Yes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-pre-check-status --dts-job-id i03e3zty16i0000 --page-no 1 --page-size 30 --job-code 01 --struct-type before --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --struct-phase View --name dewuprop --zero-etl-job false --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribePreCheckStatus --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId i03e3zty16i0000 --PageSize 30 --StructType before --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz4us4iruleja' --StructPhase View --JobCode 01 --ZeroEtlJob false --PageNo 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name dewuprop
